patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts are used for content sections, often pairing a large image or text block with a smaller, detailed content area, creating visual interest and generous whitespace.

A sophisticated typographic hierarchy combines an elegant serif for main headings, a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, and a distinctive, decorative serif for product names, creating a luxurious and editorial feel.
A muted, natural color palette features an off-white background, deep black text, and a specific, subtle blue used sparingly for accents and interactive elements.

No scroll-triggered motion is observed on the main page content; sections simply scroll into view without fade-ins, slide-ups, or parallax effects. The age gate is a modal that appears on page load, not on scroll.
Full-bleed, high-quality, art-directed photography is consistently used for hero sections and as background elements in content blocks, enhancing the premium brand image.

technique_notes: The site employs a static scroll experience, where content simply moves up the viewport without any scroll-triggered animations, parallax effects, or sticky element transformations. Visual interest is maintained through strong typography and photography rather than dynamic motion.

Typography is layered using distinct font families: a classic serif for prominent headings, a clean sans-serif for readability in body text, and a unique decorative serif for product names, all carefully sized to establish a clear visual hierarchy.

Layouts utilize a flexible grid system with significant padding and margin to create an airy, spacious feel, often featuring large, impactful images alongside text blocks that are intentionally offset or asymmetrical.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif headings (approx. 2-3x body) are paired with a distinctive decorative serif for product names, while body text uses a clean, readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — with generous padding around sections and content blocks, creating a spacious and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its sophisticated blend of classic and modern typography, particularly the unique decorative serif used for product names, combined with artful, minimalist photography. This creates an exceptionally luxurious and editorial brand experience that elevates it beyond a typical e-commerce site.
